mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may potentiate montelukast's effects through CYP3A4 inhibition and additive CNS effects, with theoretical risk of serotonin syndrome due to montelukast's weak serotonergic activity.
action: Monitor for increased montelukast adverse effects (dizziness, headache) and signs of serotonin syndrome; consider alternative asthma/allergy agent if feasible or use with caution under close clinical supervision.
